_comment: Universal Login theme, mapped from the console's dark tokens in
Keys beginning with _ are stripped before this is sent (see withoutComments
in ../auth0.ts) — the Management API rejects unknown fields.
This is the complete Free-plan branding contract. Spacing, control height,
widget width, line-height and letter-spacing have no theme fields, so they
remain Auth0 defaults unless the tenant is upgraded for page templates.
fonts.font_url carries the IBM Plex Mono Regular face. The theme API accepts
one font URL, so Auth0 may synthesize heavier text from that face.
Auth0 validates all three radius fields with a minimum of 1 even when the
style is sharp, so 1 is the closest API-valid representation of square.
The logo and woff2 file ship with the dashboard from public/auth0.
Their content hashes are part of the filenames and recorded in ASSETS.md.
Bootstrap resolves __BOXLITE_STACK_DOMAIN__ from the selected stage and
refuses to apply unless every asset has the expected MIME type and CORS.
